sheets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Produce a studio FOOD PHOTOGRAPHY contact sheet for a vocabulary app. Exactly EIGHT independent isolated product photographs in a precise FOUR-column TWO-row grid, landscape canvas aspect ratio 2:1 (ideally 2048x1024). All eight cells equal square size. Centers x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%; y=25%,75%. Every subject entirely inside its own cell, generous white space at least 12% of each cell around the full subject. Pure WHITE opaque seamless background across entire sheet, soft diffuse studio light, very faint short contact shadows, natural fresh realistic colors and textures, sharp focus on entire food object, commercial produce photography, consistent scale/composition. NO illustration, clipart, painting, 3D render, bowls, plates, baskets, utensils, hands, scenery, labels, writing, letters, numbers, cell borders, grid lines, watermarks. Keep subjects separate with clean blank white horizontal and vertical gutters so sheet can be cut into eight individual square images. Only the specified food in each cell, not a mixed fruit arrangement. Ordered row-major positions: TOP row column 1: a pair of ripe DARK burgundy sweet cherries, large plump heart-shaped fruit with joined stems. TOP row column 2: one whole ripe red apple with a small green leaf. TOP row column 3: three unpeeled ordinary brown potatoes with natural earthy skin. TOP row column 4: one whole golden yellow bulb onion and one onion half showing rings. BOTTOM row column 1: a small loose pile of dried red kidney beans, no peas and no green pods. BOTTOM row column 2: one bright yellow lemon and a cut lemon half showing pale yellow flesh. BOTTOM row column 3: one bunch of purple grapes with a short vine stem. BOTTOM row column 4: one fresh dark green knobbly cucumber and a few round slices showing pale green flesh.
